item.title: CVE-2026-131804 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | The Seraphinite Accelerator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'HTTP_USER_AGENT' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.31 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. Exploitation requires that an administrator has previously enabled the 'Enable logging' and 'HTTP trace' diagnostic options in the plugin's Advanced → Debug settings, both of which are disabled by default.

item.title: CVE-2026-101340 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1 | Net::DNS uses a 16-bit query ID to match responses to the corresponding requests. In versions up to and including 1.57, the ID is obtained from Perl's built-in rand() function. An attacker that can observe the sequence of query IDs is able to expose the internal state of the PNRG and hence predict query IDs before they are transmitted. The victim Net::DNS instance is then exposed to forged responses injected by the attacker. Note that the deduplication cache in 1.57 has no impact on the feasibility of this attack.

item.title: CVE-2026-80188 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.8
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.8 | The BuddyBoss Addons plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in versions up to, and including, 1.2.1. This is due to the Social Login REST endpoint trusting unverified Apple and Facebook identity-token claims and linking an attacker-controlled provider identifier to an existing WordPress user selected by the token’s email claim. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers who know a user’s email address to associate their provider identity with that account, including administrator accounts, and subsequently authenticate as the victim. Successful exploitation requires the BuddyBoss Platform plugin to be installed and active, with the Social Login module and selected provider enabled and configured. On sites with the separate BuddyBoss App JWT component, the vulnerable REST request can return an application token immediately.
